banner: A FOLIO demonstration. Not legal advice.
title: See your story through the law
intro: Describe a situation. Explore the issues, the facts that support them, and the FOLIO concepts that connect them.
keyHelp: Get a key from your provider. A typical intake may cost cents to a few dollars; model, story length and provider prices determine the total.
privacy: Your key stays in this browser tab and is sent only with your requests; nothing is saved.
keyError: Enter a valid API key for the selected provider to analyze your story.
reference: Quality is verified only on {{model}}, the reference model. You can still run this analysis.
consentRequired: Agree to AI processing before starting.
storyRequired: Enter your story or upload a PDF.
rejected: The provider rejected your key. Check the key and provider, then retry.
quota: The provider or showcase reached a limit. Check your provider quota or wait, then retry.
network: The connection dropped. Check your connection, then retry. Your story is still here.
failed: Analysis stopped. Retry analysis to continue with your story.
statePrompt: Confirm or choose the state where this happened to check its deadline rules.
contractual: Contractual date — stated in your document, not a legal deadline
no_verified_rule: No verified rule for this deadline
unknown_state: Choose a state to check deadlines
noDeadlines: No verified deadlines were returned. Check with legal self-help.
eraseDetails: This removes the session data and clears this tab’s key. Export your memo first if you want a copy.
idle: This session will expire soon. Export your memo or keep the session.
expired: Your session expired. The session data was erased.
pendingErase: Ending the session and erasing its data…
